in_marathi.name: Garvita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pride, Arrogance, or Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Garvita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Garvita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'garv' which means pride, arrogance, or delight. This name is often given to a girl to express the parents' hope that she will always carry herself with dignity and self-respect. In Hindu mythology, Garvita is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
